decisions.evidence: R1 maker assumption 4: 'no automatic page-title/thumbnail fetching in v1'; R1 client: 'I expect the app to collect its title, description, favicon, and preview image automatically, while letting me edit the title and description.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Maker explicitly excluded auto-metadata (contradicts REF-BM-02/03); client supplied reference-conforming behavior.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker listed 'duplicate links' only as an edge case; R1 client: 'Saving an address that already exists should take me to the existing bookmark for editing, not allow a duplicate.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Client supplied the convergence-to-edit behavior for duplicates.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker scope (P1-P3) omitted notes; R1 client: 'Each bookmark should also support a note'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Requested missing reference feature.

decisions.evidence: R1 scope omitted read-state; R1 client: 'an unread/read-later state ... with separate unread and archived views.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Requested missing unread state and separate view.

decisions.evidence: R1 scope had delete but no archiving; R1 client: 'and archiving ... Archived links should be hidden from normal browsing and search, with separate ... archived views.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Requested missing archive feature and separate archived view.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Browse & open | See your list'; R1 client: 'The normal list should clearly show the title, description, tags, and favicon.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Client added the readability-first per-item field requirement (tags/favicon depend on omitted features).

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Search by keyword'; R1 client: 'Search needs to cover the title, description, note, and address without caring about capitalization.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Client expanded full-text search fields and added case-insensitivity.

decisions.evidence: R1 scope omitted tag-syntax search; R1 client: 'I also want `#tag` searches'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Requested missing #tag search.

decisions.evidence: R1 scope omitted phrase search; R1 client: 'exact phrases'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Requested missing exact-phrase search.

decisions.evidence: R1 scope omitted boolean search; R1 client: 'combinations using AND, OR, NOT, and parentheses.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Requested missing boolean/parenthesized search.

decisions.evidence: R1 scope omitted sort; R1 client: 'Please include sorting'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Requested missing sort.

decisions.evidence: R1 scope omitted autocomplete; R1 client: 'tag suggestions from tags I already use'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Requested missing tag autocomplete.

decisions.evidence: R1 scope omitted bulk; R1 client: 'selecting several bookmarks for bulk changes'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Requested missing multi-select bulk action.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'applying an action to everything matching the current view.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Requested missing apply-to-whole-matching action.

decisions.evidence: R1 scope omitted bundles; R1 client: 'saved reusable searches'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Requested missing saved-search/bundle feature.

decisions.evidence: R1 scope omitted snapshots; R1 client: 'page snapshots—including keeping PDFs as PDFs'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Requested missing snapshot feature with PDF passthrough.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'Internet Archive saving'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Requested missing Internet Archive save.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker assumption 4: 'no auto-import from a browser'; R1 client: 'importing browser bookmarks should not be ruled out: Netscape-style bookmark-file import and export should be included.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Maker explicitly excluded import; client reversed with reference-conforming Netscape import/export.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'basic display preferences such as sorting, number of items shown, and font size.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Requested missing display preferences.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Save a bookmark | Enter an address ... saved'; client did not contest.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Presented and conforming.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Browse & open ... click to open the original page'; not contested.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Presented and conforming.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker P2: 'Edit & delete | Fix or remove bookmarks, with a delete confirmation.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Single delete presented and conforming (distinction from archive clarified later at R2).

decisions.evidence: R1 maker P3: 'tag bookmarks'; not contested as absent.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Tag assignment presented and conforming.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker P3: 'filter by tag'; R2 client later asked to make 'Clicking a tag filters the list' explicit.
decisions.note: Spec gate. REF-BM-11 was present from R1; the R2 request to make it explicit is a UI-equivalent clarification, not a new reference divergence.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker: 'edit title/description'; R2 client: 'I need to be able to edit a bookmark's address, title, description, tags, and note, both while saving ... and afterward.'
decisions.note: Spec gate (revision review). Presented edit scope was partial; client supplied full reference edit scope.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker table emphasized archive; R2 client: 'I also need to be able to permanently delete a single bookmark; archiving should remain a separate, reversible action.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Client made the permanent-delete-vs-reversible-archive distinction explicit (REF-BM-27).

decisions.evidence: R2 had 'Note' without rendering rules; R2 client: 'Notes support Markdown and are rendered when viewed.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Client supplied the markdown-render requirement (distinct refinement from R1 note capture).

decisions.evidence: R2 client: 'A tag search combined with ordinary words requires both to match.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Client added the reference edge rule that #tag and full-text combine with AND.

decisions.evidence: R2 client: 'Search words AND, OR, and NOT can be searched literally when quoted.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Client supplied the REF-BM-15 rule that operators must be quoted to be literal.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker: saved search = 'query+filters+sort'; R2 client: 'Saved searches can specifically include some tags and exclude others.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Client supplied the reference bundle's included/excluded-tags structure.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker: 'Local page snapshot (PDF kept as PDF)'; R2 client: 'A normal webpage snapshot is stored as a self-contained HTML file, while a PDF remains a PDF.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Client supplied the single self-contained-HTML rule (REF-BM-24).

decisions.evidence: R2 maker: Netscape import/export; R2 client: 'Import preserves the bookmark's title, tags, and original date added, not just its address and title.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Client supplied the reference field-preservation requirement (title, tags, date added).

decisions.evidence: R3 client: 'the app should not create separate duplicate tags with the same name. Reusing an existing tag name should always refer to that same tag'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Client added the Tag-entity uniqueness constraint ('Name unique within the user scope') missing from the presented spec.

decisions.evidence: R5 plan async metadata (pending→complete) without edit-protection; R5 client: 'delayed page details must never overwrite a title or description I entered myself ... Automatic details should fill only fields I have not customized, and this should be tested.'
decisions.note: Plan review gate. Client supplied the edit-persistence safeguard protecting REF-BM-03's guarantee that user edits survive; latent divergence in the presented async plan.

decisions.evidence: R7 tasks T038-T040 under-specified the match set; R8 maker confirms it previously used a bare 'q'. R7 client: 'It must respect every part of the current view—not only the search words—including a clicked tag filter, unread or archived view, and the included or excluded tags from a saved search ... including matching items on later pages.'
decisions.note: Tasks review gate. Client supplied the reference edge rule that apply-to-all-matching is scoped to the complete current filter (search/tag/perspective), across pages.
